title: US journalist vanished in Syria 14 years ago; now his driver’s shocking betrayal is revealed
summary_full: Austin Tice, a journalist, disappeared in Syria in 2012 while covering the civil war.  New BBC findings suggest his driver betrayed him to the Syrian regime for rewards.  Confidential intelligence files indicate the Syrian government detained Tice after his alleged abduction.  His mother maintains he is alive and being treated well by his captors.  The US government continues its active investigation and offers a reward for his return.
